title: Matrix Hilbert 90: an invariant basis for a locally constant Galois cocycle
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $S$ its separable closure, $G=\mathrm{Gal}(S/K)$ with the Krull topology, and $n\in\mathbb N$. Let $b:G\to\mathrm{GL}_n(S)$ be locally constant, and assume $b(g)g(b(h))=b(gh)$ for every $g,h\in G$, where $g$ acts entrywise on matrices. Then there exists $t\in\mathrm{GL}_n(S)$ such that $b(g)g(t)=t$ for every $g\in G$. This includes $n=0$.

source.place: Tag 03R7, injectivity argument, expanded general-linear invariant-basis descent

proof.text: A locally constant map from the compact absolute Galois group to a discrete set has finite image and factors through a finite quotient by an open normal subgroup N. The cocycle law implies b(1)=1. Intersect N with the open normal subgroups fixing the entries of all matrices in this finite image. The resulting fixed field L is finite Galois over K; b is trivial on N and gives a cocycle on Gamma=Gal(L/K) with entries in L.
For v in L^n define T(v)=sum over g in Gamma of b(g)g(v). The cocycle equation gives b(h)h(T(v))=sum_g b(hg)hg(v)=T(v), by reindexing the finite sum. No division by the order of Gamma is used.

The invariant vectors T(v) span L^n. Otherwise choose a nonzero linear functional lambda annihilating their span. Evaluate on v=r e_j: for all r, sum_g (lambda*b(g))_j g(r)=0. Independence of the distinct field automorphisms over L, as in Mathlib linearIndependent_algHom_toLinearMap composed with AlgEquiv.coe_toAlgHom_injective, makes every coefficient zero. At g=1 the coefficient equals lambda_j because b(1)=1; hence lambda=0, a contradiction.

Extract an L-basis of n vectors from this spanning set and use it as the columns of t. The matrix is invertible and all its columns are invariant, so b(g)g(t)=t. Embed L into S. The factorization through Gamma extends this equality to every automorphism of S/K. For n=0 the empty matrix is the unique unit and satisfies the equality.

theorem exists_galois_matrix_invariant_basis (K : Type u) [Field K] (n : ℕ)
    (b : Gal(SeparableClosure K/K) →
      Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K))
    (hb : IsLocallyConstant b)
    (hcoc : ∀ g h, b g * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map g.toRingHom (b h) = b (g * h)) :
    ∃ t : Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup (Fin n) (SeparableClosure K),
      ∀ g, b g * Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.map g.toRingHom t = t
